title: rbac v2: enforce tenant KMS region pinning + audit logging for Private deployments
author: Ava Patel
description: Motivation: Private deployments allow customers to supply their own KMS keys and choose region-local key policies. We need RBAC v2 policy gates that: 1) enforce tenant-level KMS region pinning for encryption operations so keys cannot be used outside approved regions; 2) ensure audit logging captures KMS key ID, region, and effective RBAC decision on every encryption/decryption key operation; and 3) provide a migration path from audit-only to enforcement without downtime. This PR implements the enforcement logic in the RBAC v2 layer, adds KMS-region metadata to audit entries, exposes a config flag to toggle enforcement per-tenant, and includes failing-mode safe guards for private installs. Changes are additive but include a small migration step to populate tenant KMS region metadata. Checklist: - [x] RBAC v2 policy rule math and unit tests - [x] KMS region pinning enforcement with tenant-level config - [x] Audit logging extended with kms_key_id, kms_region, rbac_decision - [x] Migration job to backfill tenant_kms_region (idempotent) - [x] E2E test against private-installer image in staging - [x] Docs + release notes - [x] Security review sign off (SEC-412) Summary of changes: - rbac/v2: add PolicyCondition KMSRegionAllowlist and enforcement hook that consults tenant metadata and the request's kms_region header - audit: add structured fields kms_key_id, kms_region, rbac_decision and wire them into the private-control-plane audit stream - private-installer: add post-install migration job that populates tenant_kms_region from installer config or prompts operator for action - kms integration: validate region of provided KMS key on onboarding and surface warnings in the console - config: tenant.config.enforce_kms_region boolean flag (default:false) so customers can rollout in audit mode then flip to enforce Testing: unit tests added for PolicyCondition, integration tests exercise migration job and enforcement toggle, manual pen-test validation performed by Security. Rollout plan: 1) Deploy with enforce_kms_region=false globally and enable audit logging for all private deployments; 2) Run migration to populate tenant metadata; 3) Monitor audit logs for region violations for two weeks; 4) Flip tenant.config.enforce_kms_region=true per-tenant after confirmation. Rollback: flip enforce flag to false; migration is idempotent and non-destructive. Related: ENG-2094 (RBAC v2 policy extensibility), SEC-412 (security review), SUP-1127 (support ticket from customer requesting region pinning).

release_notes: Private deployments: new tenant-level KMS region pinning. Admins can run the included migration in dry-run mode to audit region usage before enabling enforcement. Audit logs now include kms_key_id and kms_region for key operations.
migration_notes: Migration job is idempotent, supports --dry-run, and writes a migration_status entry to tenant.meta. Operators must run migration before enabling enforcement for tenants with unmanaged keys.
testing_summary: Unit tests cover new PolicyCondition and audit formatting. Integration test exercises migration + enforcement toggle. Staging private-installer image used for manual E2E. Security performed a brief key-onboarding pen-test.
notes_for_ops: When upgrading private-control-plane, set tenant.config.enforce_kms_region=false, run migration with --dry-run then without dry-run, monitor audit logs (search for rbac_decision: DENY + kms_region mismatch) before flipping enforcement per-tenant.
sensitive_changes: Adds audit of kms_key_id and kms_region to logs; sensitive values are redacted in public logs per policy. Ensure KMS key IDs are stored per tenant and not leaked across tenants.
notes: This PR is the enforcement follow-up to earlier audit-only work. Kept default to audit mode to avoid accidental lockouts.
